name: bubble
description: A source-owned chat message bubble shape (Bubble/BubbleContent/BubbleReactions/BubbleGroup), aligned to the sent or received edge.

documentation.compositionNote: Purely presentational; no dedicated primitive dependency (task 10.1's own audit). A level below the sibling message registry item -- Message owns the avatar/header/footer row, Bubble only the rounded content shape. Upstream's content part declares asChild; not replicated, per this ecosystem's caller-composition answer (registry/ui/bubble.rs's own header comment).
documentation.accessibility: Renders as inline/block content with no assigned role; conversational structure (who sent what) should come from surrounding Message/MessageHeader content, not from Bubble's own markup (registry/ui/bubble.rs).
documentation.keyboard: No component-specific keyboard handling; not an interactive control.
